function:noctis_v2.applicability_evidenc.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION noctis_v2.applicability_evidence_current(refs jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_typeof(refs)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(refs)>0 AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(refs) r WHERE NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT FROM noctis_v2.observations o JOIN noctis_v2.content_blobs b USING(hash,representation)
      WHERE o.id::text=r->>'observation_id' AND o.revision=r->>'revision' AND o.hash=r->>'hash'
        AND o.representation=r->>'representation' AND NOT o.source_deleted AND o.superseded_by IS NULL
        AND o.retention_expired_at IS NULL))
$function$

function:noctis_v2.brief_applicability_c.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION noctis_v2.brief_applicability_current(body jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(body->'applicability_support','[]'::jsonb)) s
 WHERE (noctis_v2.case_applicability((s->>'case_id')::uuid)->>'applicability_generation') IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'generation')
 AND (body ? 'applicability_support' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM noctis_v2.case_changes ch
 WHERE ch.body->>'kind'='local_applicability' AND body::text LIKE '%'||ch.observation_id::text||'%'))
$function$

function:noctis_v2.case_applicability(uu.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION noctis_v2.case_applicability(case_uuid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
WITH cves AS (
 SELECT s.value AS cve,bool_or(noctis_v2.applicability_evidence_current(jsonb_build_array(s.evidence))) AS valid
 FROM noctis_v2.case_memberships m JOIN noctis_v2.observable_sightings s ON s.observation_id=m.observation_id
 WHERE m.case_id=case_uuid AND s.observable_type='cve' GROUP BY s.value
), pairs AS (
 SELECT c.cve,c.valid,e.asset_id,e.asset_revision,e.generation,e.snapshot_id,e.expires_at,
 CASE WHEN c.valid THEN COALESCE(e.effective_status,'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS status,
 COALESCE(e.freshness,'pending') AS freshness
 FROM cves c LEFT JOIN noctis_v2.applicability_effective e USING(cve)
), aggregate AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(status='affected_version') THEN 'affected_version'
   WHEN count(*)>0 AND bool_and(status='not_affected_version' AND asset_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'not_affected_version'
   ELSE 'unknown' END AS status,
   COALESCE(bool_or(freshness<>'current' OR NOT valid OR asset_id IS NULL),true) AS pending,
   md5(COALESCE(string_agg(cve||':'||COALESCE(asset_id::text,'')||':'||COALESCE(asset_revision::text,'')||':'||COALESCE(generation,'')||':'||status||':'||valid::text,'|' ORDER BY cve,asset_id),'')) AS generation,
   min(expires_at) AS expires_at FROM pairs
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('local_applicability',status,'local_exposure','unknown',
 'applicability_generation',generation,'applicability_pending',pending,'applicability_expires_at',expires_at,
 'priority_reason',CASE status WHEN 'affected_version' THEN 'inventory_version_matches_published_range'
   WHEN 'not_affected_version' THEN 'inventory_versions_excluded_by_published_ranges' ELSE 'applicability_unknown' END)
FROM aggregate
$function$

function:noctis_v2.case_effective_body(u.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION noctis_v2.case_effective_body(case_uuid uuid, historical jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT historical||jsonb_build_object('historical_local_applicability',historical->'local_applicability')
   ||noctis_v2.case_applicability(case_uuid)
$function$

function:noctis_v2.change_effective_body.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION noctis_v2.change_effective_body(case_uuid uuid, historical jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN historical->>'kind'='local_applicability' THEN historical||jsonb_build_object(
   'historical',true,'effective_status',noctis_v2.case_applicability(case_uuid)->>'local_applicability',
   'current_for_alerts',COALESCE(historical->>'applicability_generation'=noctis_v2.case_applicability(case_uuid)->>'applicability_generation',false))
 ELSE historical END
$function$

function:noctis_v2.select_current_nvd(te.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION noctis_v2.select_current_nvd(requested_cve text)
 RETURNS TABLE(cve text, snapshot_id uuid, body jsonb, nvd_revision timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone, selection_reason text, generation text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
WITH raw_records AS (
  SELECT f.cve,f.snapshot_id,f.body,s.as_of,s.expires_at,
    noctis_v2.nvd_revision(f.body->>'lastModified') AS nvd_revision
  FROM noctis_v2.vulnerability_facts f JOIN noctis_v2.feed_snapshots s ON s.id=f.snapshot_id WHERE s.kind='nvd' AND f.cve=requested_cve
), records AS (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN nvd_revision IS NULL THEN body ELSE (body-'lastModified')||jsonb_build_object('lastModified',nvd_revision) END AS semantic_body FROM raw_records
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *,max(nvd_revision) OVER(PARTITION BY cve) AS newest_revision,
    max(as_of) OVER(PARTITION BY cve) AS newest_legacy FROM records
), candidates AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE nvd_revision=newest_revision OR (newest_revision IS NULL AND as_of=newest_legacy)
), picked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(cve) * FROM candidates ORDER BY cve,as_of DESC,snapshot_id
), selected AS (
  SELECT p.*,CASE
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FROM candidates c WHERE c.cve=p.cve AND c.semantic_body<>p.semantic_body) THEN 'conflicting_nvd_revision'
    WHEN p.newest_revision IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM records r WHERE r.cve=p.cve AND r.nvd_revision IS NULL AND r.as_of>=p.as_of) THEN 'unversioned_nvd_record'
    ELSE '' END AS selection_reason FROM picked p
)
SELECT cve,snapshot_id,body,nvd_revision,expires_at,selection_reason,
  md5(snapshot_id::text||':'||body::text||':'||selection_reason) AS generation FROM selected
$function$

view:applicability_effective.definition:
WITH assets AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_versions.id) asset_versions.id,
            asset_versions.revision,
            asset_versions.cpe,
            asset_versions.version,
            asset_versions.evidence,
            asset_versions.producer,
            asset_versions.created_at
           FROM noctis_v2.asset_versions
          ORDER BY asset_versions.id, asset_versions.revision DESC
        ), evaluated AS (
         SELECT n.cve,
            a.id AS asset_id,
            a.revision AS asset_revision,
            n.snapshot_id,
            n.nvd_revision,
            n.generation,
            n.expires_at,
            p.status,
            p.reason,
            p.calculated_at,
            p.calculated_at AS created_at,
            p.snapshot_id AS calculated_snapshot_id,
            p.asset_revision AS calculated_asset_revision,
            p.generation AS calculated_generation,
                CASE
                    WHEN n.selection_reason <> ''::text THEN n.selection_reason
                    WHEN n.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() THEN 'feed_snapshot_stale'::text
                    WHEN NOT noctis_v2.applicability_evidence_current(a.evidence) THEN 'asset_evidence_unavailable'::text
                    WHEN p.generation IS DISTINCT FROM n.generation OR p.asset_revision IS DISTINCT FROM a.revision THEN 'calculation_pending'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS invalid_reason
           FROM noctis_v2.nvd_current_selection n
             CROSS JOIN assets a
             LEFT JOIN noctis_v2.applicability_current p ON p.cve = n.cve AND p.asset_id = a.id
        )
 SELECT cve,
    asset_id,
    asset_revision,
    snapshot_id,
    nvd_revision,
    generation,
    expires_at,
    status,
    reason,
    calculated_at,
    created_at,
    calculated_snapshot_id,
    calculated_asset_revision,
    calculated_generation,
    invalid_reason,
        CASE
            WHEN invalid_reason = ''::text THEN status
            ELSE 'unknown'::text
        END AS effective_status,
        CASE
            WHEN invalid_reason = ''::text THEN 'current'::text
            WHEN invalid_reason = 'calculation_pending'::text THEN 'pending'::text
            ELSE 'stale'::text
        END AS freshness,
    'unknown'::text AS local_exposure
   FROM evaluated;

view:applicability_work_status.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.idempotency_key,
    r.scope,
    r.input_id,
    r.input_revision,
    r.calculation_version,
    r.parent_id,
    r.due_at,
    r.state,
    r.phase,
    r.page,
    r.cursor,
    r.upper_bound,
    r.case_upper_bound,
    r.pairs_processed,
    r.cases_processed,
    r.created_at,
    r.updated_at,
    r.id::text AS generation,
        CASE
            WHEN (j.state = ANY (ARRAY['quarantined'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'dependency_blocked'::text, 'budget_blocked'::text])) OR failed_child.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed'::text
            WHEN r.state = 'complete'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
               FROM noctis_v2.applicability_requests child
              WHERE child.parent_id = r.id AND child.state <> 'complete'::text)) THEN 'complete'::text
            ELSE 'pending'::text
        END AS calculation_state,
    COALESCE(failed_child.id, j.id) AS job_id,
    COALESCE(failed_child.state, j.state) AS job_state,
    COALESCE(failed_child.attempts, j.attempts) AS attempts,
    COALESCE(failed_child.last_error_code, j.last_error_code) AS last_error_code
   FROM noctis_v2.applicability_requests r
     LEFT JOIN noctis_v2.jobs j ON j.stage = 'applicability'::text AND j.input_id = r.id AND j.input_revision = r.page::text AND j.policy_version = r.calculation_version AND j.schema_version = '1'::text
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cj.id,
            cj.state,
            cj.attempts,
            cj.last_error_code
           FROM noctis_v2.applicability_requests child
             JOIN noctis_v2.jobs cj ON cj.stage = 'applicability'::text AND cj.input_id = child.id AND cj.input_revision = child.page::text
          WHERE child.parent_id = r.id AND (cj.state = ANY (ARRAY['quarantined'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'dependency_blocked'::text, 'budget_blocked'::text]))
          ORDER BY cj.id
         LIMIT 1) failed_child ON true;

view:nvd_current_selection.definition:
SELECT c.cve,
    current.snapshot_id,
    current.body,
    current.nvd_revision,
    current.expires_at,
    current.selection_reason,
    current.generation
   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT vulnerability_facts.cve
           FROM noctis_v2.vulnerability_facts) c
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL noctis_v2.select_current_nvd(c.cve) current(cve, snapshot_id, body, nvd_revision, expires_at, selection_reason, generation);
